candidates.reason: The event-date copy is crammed into a narrow column beside GLOBAL TRADESHOW, so it breaks into 7 short lines. The frame sits empty around a stray divider dash, and the product photo is shrunk into a small strip at the bottom. The grey band cuts the layout in two with no clear purpose.

The divider line runs through the 'T' of HOME TEXTILES, an unwanted collision in the headline. The event line is placed above the tagline, so the reading order is wrong. The frame is empty, and the photo is a tiny cropped strip cut off at the bottom with a gap above it.

This is the original shrunk and dropped into the centre with no rearranging. The tagline, event line and address become tiny and hard to read at this size, and big empty bands sit above and below. Brand and imagery are intact, but it is just a shrink.

Clear hierarchy (big headline, subtitle, well-wrapped event line) and the elements stack top to bottom in sequence. But the frame is an empty box with a stray divider dash in the middle of the canvas. The photo is reduced to a small thumbnail and the address is tiny.
